Hi Meera, Ashwin,

Quick note from Redwood: we’re launching a 2-week Solution Partner Lab (May 12-23) — the goal is to help consulting partners demonstrate hands-on integration with Redwood Inference and earn a "Solution Partner Lab" badge that shows joint delivery readiness. This is targeted at SI teams that will be building production inference pipelines for customers.

What’s included:
- 2 live lab sessions (architecture + ops), recorded
- Hands-on tasks: model routing, autoscaling policy, KV-cache optimizations
- Graded delivery checklist and short demo evaluation
- Badge issued upon passing the demo and checklist

Attached: badge-criteria.pdf (rubric), lab-schedule.xlsx (timeline), pre-lab-checklist.md (sandbox prep).

Ask: please confirm a single point-of-contact and up to 4 engineers who will attend. We’ll run a 30-minute orientation the week of May 5 to walk through the rubric and environment.

Laura and Priyom — can you own the orientation and evaluation slots?

Thanks,
Karthik
